correctness.rationale: For every full tuple of agent neighborhoods, its nonempty intersection is a clique of the joint-outcome conflict graph, so a proper coloring is injective on that intersection. Pick p with largest b_p. The mixed residue tuple ((t_j-t_p) mod b_j) for j≠p reaches every signature in every fixed-agent-label slice because b_p≥b_i, and complement product at p >= chromatic number. Compose with a surjection onto colors and select uniquely the prescribed-color outcome if present, otherwise a fallback in the intersection. Every transition stays in each selected neighborhood; for each action and each u in its neighborhood, uniform range supplies other neighborhoods containing u and slice-surjectivity supplies its color, giving exact outcome-set equality. Independent asymmetric-slice tests agreed for five multiplicity vectors; all-size conclusion follows construction, not finite tests.
